lede: The biggest item this week is Monday's Norwood Planning and Zoning meeting, where the commission takes up Ordinance No. ___ Series 2026 to formally adopt Phase I of Norwood's Land Use Code rewrite — the kind of foundational change that sets development rules for years to come. Monday also brings the Gondola Subcommittee's deep dive into how the gondola project gets funded and who drives it. Tuesday is a full day: Town Council holds three public hearings on second reading, the Housing Authority considers converting two affordable ownership units at 215 East Colorado to employee dwelling units with no price cap, and the School Board votes on resolutions backing Proposition NN and Amendment 87. Wednesday, the County Commissioners continue a public hearing on adopting updated International Building Codes for San Miguel County.

notable.stake: Commission votes to adopt Norwood's Land Use Code rewrite, reshaping local development rules.
Board votes on resolutions backing Proposition NN and Amendment 87, and approves revised policies.
Resolution would convert two affordable ownership units to employee dwellings, removing price caps.
Three public hearings on second reading, including the 215 E. Colorado deed-restriction conversion.
Continued public hearing on adopting new county building codes affecting all future construction.
